about.title: A bit about who I am
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Apu — an Associate Software Engineer at Cefalo Bangladesh Ltd., where I build modern web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Node.js.

Alongside my day job, I'm a passionate competitive programmer, problem setter, and former trainer at AUST ACM Lab 2, with 28+ national inter-university contests under my belt — the highest individual participation record from AUST.

I served as Vice President of the AUST Programming and Informatics Club, where I led the organization of the AUST Inter University Programming Contest 2025, and I'm a three-time Intra-AUST Programming Contest champion.
Outside of code, I enjoy game development, photography, and exploring the universe through astronomy — always chasing the next interesting problem.

vp.role: Vice President, AUST Programming and Informatics Club (AUSTPIC)
points: Led the organization of the national AUST Inter University Programming Contest 2025 — sponsor outreach, logistics and communications.
Organized beginner programming contests and seminars, partnering with other university clubs to grow the programming community.
Mentored students in algorithms and data structures, and conducted mock contests to prepare them for national and international competitions.
Organized internal contests and training sessions for the university's competitive programming community.
